text: We can't close: our funds are tied up.
Per the assignment agreement, buyer #4's $10,000 deposit is non-refundable after inspection. Contract offered the same day to backup buyer #7 (vetted, standby) at $215,000; accepted in 2 hours.
Asked counsel in writing for a 7-day extension of the closing (buyer #7 closes in 21 days and agreed to 7 with an expedited title update).
Closed with buyer #7. Assignment fee $15,000. Buyer #4's forfeited $10,000 released to Emporium Investments per the assignment agreement.
Fee $15,000 plus forfeited deposit $10,000, less $3,000 moving help and $250 inspections. Buyer #4: red flag 'failed to close', standby removed (Buyer-List).
